subject: Resolved-briefs endpoint: lab-manager returns per-session substituted briefs without grading
description: Chris finding (2026-07-09): pre-grade mission checklist shows '(shown in the BRIEFING file inside your box)' for $MISSION_* tokens because the catalog substitutes with an empty env. Proper fix: lightweight lab-manager GET endpoint (readMissionEnv + substituteTokens, one exec, NO check sweep) so the workspace can paint fully resolved briefs post-launch. Depends on SBX-8 restart-reseed fix. bc1 deploy required.
